Eleni (Marketing): Quick brainstorm: 25m developer launch + a tiny benchmark note + 80 starter credits. Goal: convert console visitors to product-active.
Marco (Growth): Short, tactical. Suggest 2 prompt templates with 1-click run and a progressive credit unlock.
Sofia (Product): We can show per-prompt estimated tokens & latency in the UI during demo. That benchmark will be the hook.
Mei (Onboarding): Credit plan: 20 on signup, 60 after completing 2/3 checklist steps (create key, run prompt). Helps reduce abuse.
Raj (Ops): Routing: demo -> pool "dev-launch-1"; fallback "hosted-std". Per-user promo cap 100, expire 30d. Also org cap = 3 grantees.
Eleni (Marketing): Landing copy draft: "Ship an LLM feature in 25 minutes — live prompts, real metrics, 80 credits to ship." Keep headline punchy.
Marco (Growth): Experiment arms: A) 80 upfront, B) 20+60 gated. Holdout 25%. Metrics: signup CVR, attendance, first-run within 24h, day7 retention, cost-per-activated-user.
Sofia (Product): Prompt packs: "Bug-to-fix explainer", "Feature blurb generator". Each with starter + tweak tip. We'll instrument avg tokens per example.
Mei (Onboarding): Modal text draft: "Complete these 2 steps to unlock your remaining credits". Show balance after unlock.
Raj (Ops): Pseudo-config:
```
cohort: dev-launch-apr
pool: dev-launch-1
max_qps: 75
fallback: hosted-std
```
CalBot: Event scheduled: "Dev Launch: 25m demo + credits" on 2026-04-08 17:00 UTC. Attendees: Eleni, Marco, Sofia, Raj, Mei.
Eleni (Marketing): Action items: Marco = experiment wiring + cohorts, Sofia = modal + prompt telemetry, Mei = checklist copy, Raj = route + caps. I'll draft landing and ad copy and share link. Reconvene after drafts. :rocket:
